name: Source Natural Foods & Herbal Supplements Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1998, Source Natural Foods 
 and Herbal Supplements Ltd provides Ayurveda, Health & Dietary Supplements and Food Products[1]
keyPoints:
Product Profile:
a) Beverages:[1]
Ojasvita - Chocolate, Malt, Strawberry, Mango, Golden Latte, etc.
b) Supplements:[2]
Turmeric Plus, Amla, Yastimadhu, Triphala, Nishamlaki, Arjuna
c) Arkas:[3]
Shakti Drops, Tulsi Araka, Ajamoda Arka
d) Single Herbs:[4]
Shakhpushpi, Shatavari, Tulsi, Neem, Brahmi, Ashwagandha, Amrut, Kalamegh, Haritaki
e) Churnas:[5]
Sitophaladi, Hingvastaka, Triphala

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
